description: Read the free daily system backup of a gameserver: whether it runs (enabled), when the customer switched it off, next and last run (null without a ZapX Pass with backups) and canSwitchOff. Read-only: switching it off or on is only possible in the dashboard or via the REST API. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: get_gameserver_daily_backup
title: Get Game Server Daily Backup
